description: Listed building consent for alterations to main house including replacement roof with natural slate, replacement roof on side extension with a single ply roofing system. Re-flaunching the chimney pots. Re-pointing chimney stack and renewing chimney stack lead cover. Repositioning of roof window and addition of one roof window. Removal of shutters on front windows. Relocation of window to the front elevation of side extension and filling in of existing window. Removal of door from the proposed plan. Replacement of rear sliding patio doors Replacement internal partitions with timber for new interior layout.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (635/OS1, 635/OS2, 635/01, 635/02, 635/03, 635/04, 635/05, 635/06, 635/07, 635/08, 635/09, 635/11C, 635/12C, 635/13C, 635/15C, 635/16C, 635/17C, 635/18C, 635/22C, Design & Heritage Impact Statement received 14 July 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution expect where specifed on the hereby approved plans.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights used shall be 'conservation' style and the frames shall be in a dark colour and shall be permanently retained as such.
